chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 594 – Li Huowang Outsmarts a Doctor and Faces a Siming’s Demand
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang gets his ex-doctor arrested and learns he must help a Siming seize the True and False Ways from Yin-Yang Doumu. The storm is here.
og_description: Li Huowang plays the system and gets Wang Wei locked up, but the Sitian Jian has bigger plans for him—and they involve stealing a Siming’s Ways.
twitter_description: Li Huowang coldly outmaneuvers his obsessive ex-doctor, only to be dragged into a celestial scheme that could destroy reality.

lore_anchors.definition: The director of celestial affairs, both a historical imperial title and a cosmic guide between the mortal world and the White Jade Capital.
A mortal who serves as a Siming’s anchor in the physical world—the god’s causal connection to reality.
A Siming who controls the True and False Ways; a corrupted star deity from Daoist mythology.
A cosmic dichotomy representing what is real versus what is cultivated into being real.
Li Huowang’s future self who has become a Siming of Bewilderment, now revealed to be a separate but identical entity.
